articles.headline: Retail Investors Fully Subscribe Ambani's Jio IPO
articles.brief: Jio Platforms' massive initial public offering achieved full subscription from retail investors on its second day, driven by overwhelming market demand and strong overall bidding momentum.

articles.headline: Barclays to Cut 5,000 Jobs in AI Cost Drive
articles.brief: British banking giant Barclays has announced plans to eliminate 5,000 positions this year as part of a sweeping operational restructure powered by artificial intelligence automation and cost-cutting initiatives.

articles.headline: LSEG to Acquire Octus in Major Data Deal
articles.brief: London Stock Exchange Group has agreed to purchase Octus in a $3.5 billion mega data analytics transaction designed to expand its global financial terminal offerings and technological capabilities.

articles.headline: India Mideast Oil Imports Return to Normal
articles.brief: India's crude oil imports from the Middle East recovered fully to pre-war baseline levels in September, signaling stability in regional supply chains despite ongoing geopolitical maritime tensions.

articles.headline: Karnataka Plans 200 Cochlear Implants for Children
articles.brief: The Karnataka government has announced an ambitious healthcare initiative targeting 200 cochlear implant surgeries for children suffering from severe hearing loss under the state's specialized welfare programs.

articles.headline: Amit Shah Vows NDA Victory in Upcoming Punjab Polls
articles.brief: Union Home Minister Amit Shah slammed the opposition during a high-profile visit, asserting that ongoing protests will fail and predicting the NDA will form the next government in Punjab.

articles.headline: India Transport Ministry Plans Automatic ADAS Mandate
articles.brief: Union Minister Nitin Gadkari revealed transport ministry plans to mandate advanced driver assistance systems and automated emergency braking features across all passenger cars manufactured starting in 2030.
